Context: II. Grounds for making ad hoc

3. Unfilled Direct Recruitment Quota.If the Direct Recruitment quota has not been filled and the RRs do not provide the filling it by transfer on deputation temporarily, the post may be filled on an ad hoc basis. - Chapter No. 20 and OM, dated 2-9-2022.
